# The Accelerated Schools

> A charter school network in South Los Angeles serving K-12 students with dual language immersion, gifted education, and college readiness programs across three campuses (ACES, TAS, and WAHS).

The Accelerated Schools is a network of charter schools operating in South Los Angeles, comprising ACES (elementary), TAS (K-8), and WAHS (high school). The organization focuses on accelerated learning, dual language immersion, and college preparation, with strong support for families and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- The Accelerated Schools
